result.summary: The page is largely well structured, but one header control appears incomplete and some horizontally scrolling content is awkwardly clipped.

issues.description: The circular control in the upper-right is an empty gray disk with only a small red notification dot, making it look like its profile/avatar icon failed to load.
issues.suggestion: Render the intended avatar or profile icon, and keep the notification badge anchored to the circle’s outer edge.

issues.description: The category chips and the third card in the “Fastest near you” carousel are sharply cut off at the right viewport edge, including truncated restaurant text.
issues.suggestion: Add clearer carousel end spacing or a consistent partial-card preview so the clipping appears intentional and text is not awkwardly severed.
